comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Root cause: the cache key omits the workspace id. Sketch and repro screenshot below.

content.text: Root cause: the cache key omits the workspace id. Sketch and repro screenshot below.

The workspace switcher dropdown shows the plan tier badge (Free, Team, Business) next to each workspace name. After an admin upgrades or downgrades a workspace, the badge in the switcher keeps showing the old tier until the user does a full browser reload.

Plan changes should surface within a few seconds of the billing webhook completing. In practice the switcher reads from a bootstrap payload cached at login and never refetches GET /workspaces/me after workspace.plan_changed.
Stale tier text causes people to open the wrong upgrade CTA or believe a paid feature is unavailable. Caching the tier on the workspace list without a subscription to plan events is the likely gap.
